features:
Key Features:

Only 70 calories per bar — a smart, portion-controlled snack option.

High in fiber — about 6 to 7 grams of fiber per bar, helping meet daily intake needs.

Low in sugar — around 2 grams of total sugar, with minimal added sugars.

Soft-baked texture — a dessert-like feel with warm cinnamon coffee cake flavor.

Convenient packaging — individually wrapped for easy snacking on the go.

Benefits:

Supports digestive health due to high fiber content.

Helps with satiety — the fiber and modest fat help you feel full longer between meals.

Diet-friendly — ideal for calorie counters, diabetics (low sugar), and those on fiber-boosting plans.

Perfect for busy lifestyles — no prep needed, great for work, school, or travel.

Satisfies sweet cravings without the guilt of high-calorie desserts.
ingredients: Chicory Root Extract, Wheat Flour Bleached, Sugarcane Fiber, Allulose, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Polydextrose, Sorbitol, Palm and Palm Kernel Oil, Sugar, Calcium Caseinate, Maltitol. Contains 2% or less of: Whey Protein Isolate, Egg White, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Cinnamon, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Locust Bean Gum, Xanthan Gum, Natural Flavor.
